nodes.title: G7 verdict clock anchors on max(last value end, child's last voiced frame) + VERDICT.delayMs (2.0 s, re-chosen on TaxilaFDB train F1: 1.2 s 2-4/40, 1.6 s 1/40, 2.0 s 0/40). Reverse if real-child sessions (PLAN ET-2) show verdicts on repaired values > 0 with this anchor, or listeners rate the 2 s verdict wait as slow.

understand.js `idk` (which licenses idk_help SPEAK) is true only when the IDK phrase is the tail of the turn (vocatives / a few particles allowed after it); `idkAny` keeps the old reading for the Director. Reverse if real transcripts show tail IDKs followed by other filler words being missed (missed idk replies > 2%).

EchoSubtractor matches her words that were audible inside the item's audio span regardless of the text's arrival time; empty-skeleton tails join a run by surface; on word-timed sources a single token whose own time sits on her same word is echo. Reverse if recorded sessions (ET-1) show children's words deleted (> 1% of answers).

Transcript tokens in a script other than Devanagari/Latin (STT hallucination, 5/90 real segments) set LexicalMarkers.unreadable: never complete, never re-voiced, backstop first sound is a verdict-free prompt; the Director should ask again. Reverse if a future STT stops hallucinating scripts (0 in 500 real segments).

Within-turn pace: the longest pause this turn after which the child resumed x TURN_PACE.k (1.3, chosen on train slow-child world: k0 12.6%/1.5% cut/missed, k1.3 10.1%/3.6%, k1.6 9.6%/6.9%) floors later backstops (cap 6 s) and the verdict delay (cap 4 s); granted holds excluded. Reverse if ET-2 shows missed replies up > 3 pt with no cut-off gain.

M-D8 (2026-10-04, $0): TaxilaFDB test split (960 streams; 732 thinking pauses, 528 respond ends, 84 distress, 40 repairs, 48 holds) under world perturbations (sttReal calibrated on the L2 real-STT transcripts n=48, slow x1.6 pauses, quiet -12 dB, phone SNR 6 dB + bursts; [E] parameters) via evals/duplex/critic/stress.mjs, pre-fix hash 1d138d3168bf and post-fix 67a0af9b6551. Post-fix base: stage A cut-offs 0.0% FAST / 0.1% D4, missed 8.7/10.6%, verdict-on-repaired 0/40, unsafe 0/84; silence-640 82.8/73.6% cut-offs; cascade-900 24.9% (D4) with 40.2% missed. sttReal: distress detected 68/84 for EVERY arm; stage A unsafe 15/84. Slow child: stage A 8.2% cut-offs, 13/40 verdict on repaired. All three stresses: stage A 17.3% cut / 23.3% missed vs silence-640 97.3% / 1.9%. Duck p50 38-70 ms; yield p50 760/1207 ms. Duplex extras cost +$0.07-0.11 per lesson-hour (sim token counts x Azure retail). Details docs/research/duplex/CRITIQUE.md.

Tried: the G7 verdict gate at last VALUE end + 2.0 s. What broke: a unit/tail word after the value ate the wait ('पंद्रह | सेंटीमीटर [1.4 s] सॉरी बारह': gate fell 90 ms before 'सॉरी'), verdict on 15 played, TaxilaFDB test F1.rep_marker 4/40 FAST. Replaced by duplex-verdict-anchor-last-voice.

Tried: idk_help licensed by an IDK phrase anywhere in the turn. What broke: 'पता नहीं … कभी कभी लगता है मैं ना' got a reply committed 30 ms after the last word, before the distress phrase was visible (TaxilaFDB test F10 after_pause). Replaced by duplex-idk-tail-only.

Tried: echo candidates = her words audible in the 2 s before the text's ARRIVAL. What broke: straddling items re-transcribed 3+ s after her question kept her tail; 92/181 stage A reply texts on a test sample began with her own last word ('है? तीन सौ साठ डिग्री'), re-voiced in the uptake. Replaced by duplex-echo-by-audio-span (0/172).

Tried: TaxilaFDB L1 with a simulated STT that returns the script verbatim as the gate for lexical and safety behaviour. What broke: the real transcriber returned only 42/90 child segments verbatim on the same streams (5/90 in another script); with calibrated errors the shared safety predicate caught 68/84 distress lines (84/84 at L1) and stage A missed replies rose 8.7 -> 15.3%. Replaced by: the sttReal world in every duplex report, and TaxilaFDB v2 on real transcripts (PLAN section 4).
